verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party help center has an 'Export your workspace data' article and an import/export tools guide, so workspace export is a product capability. Community evidence says DMs and private channels can be exported via Corporate Export, but only after Slack approves a legal or compliance justification. That gating fits 'where policy allows' and is not a contradiction. The first-party evidence is title-only, so the formats, scope and admin workflow are unproven. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable export format (e.g. JSON), confirmation of full-history scope, first-party detail on private-conversation export and the admin steps, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows

citations.quote: Guide to Slack import and export tools
Corporate Export requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval before you can export DMs and private channels.
